scope: Post-hoc numeric reconstruction of frozen synthetic simulator evidence. Descriptive disagreement and localization are not a causal intervention or hardware claim.

full_clock_hold_diagnostics.note: Progress binning uses each saved action's progress_before_s. Contact, force, and object-height values are the aligned saved trajectory observation. The simple 0.14 m height threshold is descriptive only.

recommendation.candidate: Separate acquisition-only supervisor with 20ms decisions, bilateral contact/force plus 100ms dwell and <=2mm relative drift, one-way secure latch, 1.0s wait bound, and explicit recovery.
recommendation.carried_object_guard: If load/lift suggests a possibly carried object and secure readiness is absent, hold progress and jaw command and fault; never resume/force-advance. Recovery must be bounded and evaluated separately.
recommendation.development_and_confirmation: New lineage; fresh development roster for freeze, then at least 32 unseen XY groups paired across goals and nominal/post-grip conditions; interleave fixed/full/teacher/candidate per case; preserve failures and report component outcomes, wait/recovery metrics, uncertainty, timing, and independent trace audit.
recommendation.qualification: Simulation-only evidence; no physical robot readiness, hard real-time, or transfer claim.
